The Kubbys Hair-Test Themselves To Prove
That They Are Not Using Any Drugs Less Safe Than Marijuana.

(Marijuananews note: Isn’t it wonderful how the Internet brings us stories that tell us more together than they would separately. Cybersynergy?)

See
Brewers Of Budweiser Hair-Test Employees To Be Sure
That They Are Not Using Any Drugs Less Dangerous Than The One They Make.

From Steve Kubby:

May 5, 1999

Kubbys Pass Drug Test

(LOS ANGELES) Sensitive hair analysis testing of Steve and Michele Kubby has shown them drug-free for all drugs tested. The Kubbys, who currently face a 19 count indictment for cultivation of medical marijuana, asked to be tested in response to charges by the prosecution that the Kubbys used illegal drugs.

Hair analysis is the most sensitive of drug tests, because it can look back in time and detect drug use which occurred prior to the test, up to 2 years earlier.

The tests were conducted under the supervision of Dr. Vincent DeQuattro of the USC Medical Center, using in independent laboratory and strict security measures.
See
Prominent Medical Specialist Says Steve Kubby Should Be Studied, Not Jailed;
His Case Has Major Medical Implications.

Marijuana, which the Kubbys are allowed to use as legal California medical marijuana patients, was not included in the Kubby hair tests.
